finding.title: acarsd daemon exposes its configuration without authorization
finding.description: The acarsd ACARS decoding daemon answered an unauthenticated connection with its full status document: version, API version, administrator e-mail, connected clients and listening frequencies.
finding.remediation: Enable acarsd's authorization requirement and restrict access to the daemon port to trusted networks.
